shapeSummary: Simplified Bilda dual-mode servo programmer: 48x48 mm board with 2 mm backing layer, 1.6 mm PCB, four 6 mm tactile buttons, one IC block, and two 3-pin vertical headers at the back edge reaching 14 mm total height (Y up).
warnings: Dimensions are visual estimates; the source gives none.
Height is placed on Y (14 mm) per the Y=0 bottom rule, while the analysis lists Z as height; X and Z are both 48 mm.
Corner mounting holes were omitted because their positions and diameters are uncertain.
The L-shaped notch in the backing pad, the crystal/SMD parts and the battery tray and cable were omitted.
Header pins are modeled as vertical, which is assumed from the 14 mm height estimate; in the image they may be right-angle.
Button and header positions are approximate.
